test_exact_deduplication: test exact deduplication of documents using URL-based content getter and default priority
test_exact_deduplication_priority: test exact deduplication with document priority to keep highest or lowest id from duplicate clusters
test_exact_deduplication_normalization: test exact deduplication with content normalization to treat modified strings as duplicates
test_exact_deduplication_index: test exact deduplication against a pre-built index to filter documents already seen
test_exact_deduplication_cluster_size: test exact deduplication with cluster size metadata to track duplicate counts per kept document
